note.after_visit_summary: Today we saw Ananya Iyer for her 4-year checkup. She is growing well and developing normally. The main concern is constipation: she has hard stools every few days and sometimes cries or hides when trying to go. We will start a medicine called polyethylene glycol (PEG) to help soften her stools. Give her half a capful (8.5 grams) mixed in 4 ounces of water or juice once a day. We will also reduce her milk to 2 cups per day and encourage more fruit, water, and sitting on the toilet for 5 minutes after meals. The goal is a soft stool every day or every other day. If there is no improvement in a month or if you see blood in the stool, please message us. She also received two vaccines today: DTaP-IPV and MMRV. She may have a sore leg or low fever, and a rash or fever could appear 1-2 weeks after the MMRV vaccine. If she is uncomfortable, you may give her children's acetaminophen (Tylenol) 8 mL by mouth. She takes a daily multivitamin gummy and has no known allergies. Her flu shot was given at the pharmacy on October 2nd. Her next checkup will be at age 5. Please bring her back then, or sooner if you have concerns.
